variations.new_text: The Approved Housing Provider or Registered Provider (as applicable) or their successors in title or mortgagees or Chargees shall have no liability under this Deed SAVE FOR compliance with the Affordable Housing obligations in the Third Schedule Part 1 Paragraph 1 of this Deed.

variations.new_text: The obligations contained in this Deed shall not be binding upon or enforceable against a mortgagee or a chargee of the Site (in whole or part, including mortgagees of a Dwelling) until it takes possession of the Site (in whole or part) in which case it too will be bound by the obligations as if it were a party deriving title from the Owner.

evidence.snippet: A new clause 7.16 shall be inserted in to the Original Obligation as follows

variations.target: Paragraph 1.5.1 of Part 1 of the Third Schedule (Affordable Housing)
variations.new_text: not be binding on a Chargee of an occupant or leaseholder in the event that such a Chargee seeks to dispose of an Affordable Housing Dwelling pursuant to its power of sale exercised pursuant to default of the terms of the mortgage PROVIDED THAT: (a) such Chargee shall have first given written notice to the Council of its intention to dispose of the relevant Affordable Housing Dwelling(s) (such notice to include evidence and written confirmation of the default) and shall have used reasonable endeavours over a period of three months from the date of the written notice to complete a disposal of the relevant Affordable Housing Dwelling(s) to another registered provider or to the Council for a consideration not less than the amount due and outstanding under the terms of the relevant security documentation including all accrued principal monies, interest due and reasonable costs ; and (b) if such disposal has not completed within the three month period above, the Chargee shall be entitled to dispose of the relevant Affordable Housing Dwelling(s) free from the affordable housing provisions in this Deed which provisions shall determine absolutely
